name: comp-380

frames.best_why: Dropdown is open showing Light, Dark and System rows beside the sun icon button.

tagline: A sun icon opens a tiny menu for light, dark and system themes.
summary: A square icon button shows the current appearance and opens a short menu with Light, Dark and System options. Picking one swaps the button's sun or moon icon.
appearance: A rounded dark settings card pairs 'Appearance' and a grey subtitle with a square outlined icon button at the right, holding a small sun. Clicking opens a compact dark menu directly below with sun, moon and monitor icons beside Light, Dark and System.
behaviour: Clicking the icon opens the menu; hovering highlights a row, and choosing a theme closes the menu and swaps the trigger icon between sun and moon. Nothing else on the page changes.
demo_content: Card 'Appearance' with 'Choose how the interface looks'; menu options Light, Dark and System.
search_phrases: switch between light and dark mode
change colour scheme from a menu
use_when: Users need to pick light, dark or system appearance from a compact control.
avoid_when: It only changes its own icon here; no page theme is actually applied without extra wiring.
customise: The three option labels, icons and the starting 'system' value are in the file; hooking a real theme provider means editing the click handlers.
weight_why: One tiny menu and three icons; no animation loop.

a11y.note: The trigger has an aria-label and rows are menu items; the current theme shows only as an icon, not a checked state.

issues: The demo changes only the button icon; no page theme is applied.
The open menu does not mark which theme is currently selected.
polish_why: Neat compact menu; its theme choice is cosmetic here and nothing marks the active option.
title: Theme Switcher Dropdown
